title: The First Trip at Five
synopsis: On his first morning as a five-year-old, Jack pulls the wagon through familiar Pine Park, accepts help when a wheel dips off the gravel, and ends with a quiet sense that more adventures are possible.
continuity_state: Before: Jack has turned five at the Pine Park picnic and owns a small red four-wheeled wagon. The four friends are home; Jack's existing blue notebook now holds a recent picture sent by Dr. Ada of Scout's rover still working. After: Jack remains five. The wagon is undamaged, tested on Pine Park's firm path, and parked beneath his new doorframe growth mark at home. His notebook gains a drawing of the wagon and three friends; the town, spaceport and rover remain as established. The series closes peacefully without a cliffhanger.
